entries.body:
These blocks behave just like the Copycats you know and love, except you can also send a different redstone signal to each side! 

 Take the 6 character alphanumeric string from one menu, paste it into the other menu, and that's it! Figuring out the side can be a little confusing at first, and I will tell you now that assembling/dissassembling swapped the faces for me in one test. I'm still working that out.

 Hover over the image below to learn more about the Wireless Copycat Menus.

§6§lKeyboard's Menu§r

hotspots.title: Wiki Button
hotspots.body: Access this in-game wiki anytime with this button

hotspots.title: Revert Button
hotspots.body: 'Revert' will erase, upon confirmation, all auto-saved changes. This reverts the page to a snapshot of when the menu was first opened

hotspots.title: << Tab - Back
hotspots.body: Pressing 'tab' on your keyboard goes back to the previous menu. Or press here

hotspots.title: Randomize
hotspots.body: Click here to randomize the frequency with an alphanumeric string

hotspots.title: Copy
hotspots.body: The frequency string needs to be copy/pasted between the keyboard menu and the copycat menu. It doesn't really matter which side you start on!

hotspots.title: Paste
hotspots.body: The frequency string needs to be copy/pasted between the keyboard menu and the copycat menu. It doesn't really matter which side you start on!

hotspots.title: New Line
hotspots.body: Click here to add a new line. Up to 100 frequencies!

hotspots.title: Custom Frequency Strings
hotspots.body: You can write your own frequency string, or randomize it. This is how I would set up links to an Aeronautics / offroad car with front wheel drive. The image below this one shows an example of W2's menu, which is a copycat panel on the front left of the front wheel mount on a car.

hotspots.title: Randomized Frequency Strings
hotspots.body: 58 billion possibilities! As opposed to ~2 million (assuming just Create installed, its more, with more items, of course)

hotspots.title: Delete line
hotspots.body: Luckily there's a 'revert' button if you accidentally press this!

hotspots.body: Access this in-game wiki anytime with this button

hotspots.title: Revert
hotspots.body: 'Revert' will erase, upon confirmation, all auto-saved changes. This reverts the page to a snapshot of when the menu was first opened

hotspots.title: Exit
hotspots.body: Close the menu. Everything is auto-saved!

hotspots.title: Sending / Receiving Side
hotspots.body:
The sun rises in the East! Maybe that will help here. There is also a test button (the play button on the right).
There is a bug that causes these sides to swap E->W or N->S, or just not correctly align when assembling/disassembling. This is being worked on, but it will be annoying until its fixed

hotspots.title: Enable / Disable
hotspots.body: A side must be enabled for it to send or receive signals

hotspots.title: Custom Frequency String
hotspots.body: This same string is in the image above. The menu you are seeing is a Wireless Copycat Panel on the front left (FL) of a wheel mount, on a car named Car 1. Naming can be nice if you aren't concerned about security. This is a password!
